question: Before thinking-cutting is released: on five further long tasks from three codebases, does a session with thinker on and thinking cut when older than two turns come out as correct as a session with no proxy, and what does it cost and cut?
rule: Chosen 2026-11-18 before any run, at the owner's ask for five more different tasks with a good amount of thinking: long multi-turn tasks from the Artemis archive whose prompts and criteria were frozen on or before 2026-11-04 and that the bench had not run (PostHog PR106466 and PR106917, the other two of the four website demo tasks; Django PR21834 and TypeScript PR64108, the fourteen-prompt tasks; MLflow PR26442 from the fair-turns pool). Two arms, one session each: bare (no proxy) first, which also sizes the task; then the shipped defaults with cutThinking on and thinkingKeepTurns 2, on every task whose bare session holds at least 20k tokens of thinking.
